verdict.rationale: SerpApi returns structured JSON of parsed search results, including organic and news results, which implies per-result link and title fields. Only the Events API explicitly documents titles, dates and links. The evidence never states that organic or news results carry canonical (non-redirect) URLs or published dates usable for citation. Missing for 10: explicit field documentation of link/title/date on organic and news results, any guarantee of canonical URLs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of citation-grade metadata.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on results carrying canonical URLs, titles, and published dates so my app can cite sources accurately

citations.quote: Event titles, dates, links, ticket info and more.
It can be set to `json` (default) to get a structured JSON of the results
